title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.10.17
body_markdown:
*released July 8th, 2025*

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2025-49739**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-49739) Visual Studio - Elevation Of Privilege - Time-of-check to time-of-use in Standard Collector Service allows Local privilege escalation​
* [**CVE-2025-27613**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-27613) Gitk Arguments Vulnerability​
* [**CVE-2025-27614**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-27614) Gitk Abitryary Code Execution Vulnerability​
* [**CVE-2025-46334**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-46334) Git Malicious Shell Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2025-46835**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-46835) Git File Overwrite Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2025-48384**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-48384) Git Symlink Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2025-48385**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-48385) Git Protocol Injection Vulnerability
* [**CVE-2025-48386**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-48386) Git Credential Helper Vulnerability
